coaching.headline: Murdock won the offlane all game and the winning never left the lane — majors 5-20 against us, gone in 22 minutes.
coaching.team: We drafted no healer into a comp facing Mourn, and on the map the film is one note repeated: fight after fight (10.3, 12.5, 19.1, 20.8) lost while a winning lane stayed home. The two won teamfights (13.8, 16) show the team could fight five-strong; everything else was fed piecemeal to an 8/1 Kallari.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 10.3 pick at their Fangtooth bought the 11-minute Fangtooth, and the twin 0-3s at 19.1 and 20.8 ended it — at 19.1 both winning lanes were absent, and at 20.8 the winning offlane and the midlaner never joined.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Murdock went 3/2 and won the offlane wire to wire against Adele — and the macro flags the same fix four times: at 10.3, 12.5, 19.1 and 20.8, Mr_Meat31 was alive and ahead while the team lost a short-handed fight. On a 22-minute clock, a won solo lane is a rotation license; shove the wave and arrive, because the tower gained never outweighed the 0-3s given.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Countess never got into the game — 1/2/0 with two items by the end, and a mid lane read unfavored into Howitzer while Kallari (8/1) hunted the map. With the lane read theirs all game, the play was to concede cs, ward the river and shadow the jungler — Countess is worth more attached to a teammate than alone in a losing lane.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Mourn Abduct (pull), Howitzer Land Mine (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Mourn. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 2 items of it.
Dive threat on our backline: Kallari. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Bayle Kingslayer (knockback), Countess Feast (suppress 0.75s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

ourKits.combo: Dread Nova stun → Ether Crystal push/lift → Particle Shredder channel → Synaptic Obliterator beams
ourKits.winCondition: poke from max range and zone with the crystal
ourKits.playWith: a frontline to protect his stationary channel
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova; dive him during the immobile ult channel

ourKits.combo: stance-swap with Zero Shift → Tachyon Lance (ranged) or melee chain → Limit Break on Overheat
ourKits.winCondition: build Heat and burst with Limit Break, flexing range and melee
ourKits.passive: damage builds Heat → Overheat unlocks Limit Break
ourKits.playWith: peel that lets her ramp Heat safely
ourKits.playAgainst: pressure her before Overheat; CC during the melee stance

ourKits.combo: Skull Crusher gap-close → Dire Howl slow → Cursed Edge → Kingslayer knockback dash, Berserk at low HP
ourKits.winCondition: engage, drop low into Berserk and out-brawl
ourKits.playWith: follow-up while he commits the dive
ourKits.playAgainst: his Berserk rewards low HP — burst him fully or disengage; anti-heal helps

ourKits.combo: Shadow Slip in → Eventide → Blade Siphon → Feast suppress ult, Haemorrhage true-damage
ourKits.winCondition: Feast-suppress a squishy and delete them with true-damage burst
ourKits.passive: two-ability hits apply a %max-HP true-damage bleed
ourKits.playWith: a team to clean up after her pick
ourKits.playAgainst: Feast is her whole engage — bait it / peel; she's fragile, punish the recast window

enemyKits.combo: Abduct pull → Contagion ally-heal bugs → Beguile damage-reduction → Eclipse vision-denial ult
enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and sustain the team through the brawl
enemyKits.playWith: burst that punishes his pulled target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect the long Abduct channel/range; anti-heal blunts Contagion

enemyKits.combo: Shadow Walk stealth → Crippling Dagger slow → Shadow Dance gap-close → Guillotine execute ult
enemyKits.winCondition: stealth-pick an isolated squishy and execute with Guillotine
enemyKits.passive: Death Mark detonates for bonus burst
enemyKits.playWith: a team that follows her pick
enemyKits.playAgainst: ward/reveal for the stealth; she's the squishiest hero — any CC kills her

enemyKits.combo: Slow Grenades / Land Mine zone → R2000 Missile → Make It Rain ult
enemyKits.winCondition: wall off space with mines/grenades and rain artillery on a held enemy
enemyKits.playWith: CC and chokes that force enemies into his zones
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile turret — flank his mine zones, dive when ult is down

lines: Lead story: Stayed alive, joined every fight, and each takedown sped up the ultimate. In 71% of the team's kills (more than 90% of Kallari jungle players this patch) and died 1 time (fewer than about 89% of them). Lotus turned 12 takedowns into ability haste, so Guillotine came back every ~69s instead of 110s.
Lesson: takedowns were the fuel. Each one Kallari touched shortened Guillotine, so feeding early made it come back faster (about 69.2s late); fight right after Guillotine is spent.
Guillotine at rank 2: 110s base, about 69.2s by the end (37% shorter) from 59 ability haste: Malady 8, Penumbra 20, Nex 8, Lotus 23.
12 takedowns (8 kills, 4 assists) fed: Malady (Demise), Penumbra (Essence Reaper), Lotus (Eternal).
Penumbra (Essence Reaper): On Takedown: Reduce Non-Ultimate Cooldowns by 4s.
Kallari dealt 11,009 hero damage, 18% of their team's, with +162 physical power from items.

Penetration: Malady 11, Vanquisher 12, Penumbra 9, Nex 5; against Bayle (level 13: about 130 physical armor, 93 after penetration; took 8,109 physical damage from heroes, 56% of all hero damage they took) and Argus (level 11: about 66 physical armor, 29 after penetration; took 6,407 physical damage from heroes, 55% of all hero damage they took) that is about 19% and 29% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).

Stack (Finishing damage on low-health targets): 2 effects on one trigger: Malady, Vanquisher. Once a fight started going their way, these finished it.
Stack (Kept alive in fights): 2 effects on one trigger: Malady, Lotus. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.

members.text: Every 2 minutes and every Takedown randomly grants +1% Damage, +4 Ability Haste, +0.75% Move Speed, or +1.25% Max Health.

stacks.text: 3 effects on one trigger: Malady, Penumbra, Lotus. Each kill or assist made the next fight easier.

stacks.title: Finishing damage on low-health targets

members.name: Malady
members.text: On damaging a Hero below 40% Health: Deal 20 (+15%) Damage. Gain a stack of Demise. Damage increases by 4 per stack of Demise. Takedowns reset the Cooldown.

members.name: Vanquisher
members.text: On taking a Hero below 5% Health: Execute them.

stacks.text: 2 effects on one trigger: Malady, Vanquisher. Once a fight started going their way, these finished it.

stacks.title: Kept alive in fights

members.name: Malady
members.text: On Killing a Unit: Cause them to explode. Deals Damage based on their Max Health.

members.name: Lotus
members.text: Every 2 minutes and every Takedown randomly grants +1% Damage, +4 Ability Haste, +0.75% Move Speed, or +1.25% Max Health.

stacks.text: 2 effects on one trigger: Malady, Lotus. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.

worked.eternalPart: The Eternal was part of it: Lotus (Early Bloom + Immaculate) sits on the same triggers as the items (every takedown fed; kept alive in fights), so the same fights paid out in both damage and staying power.

countered.text: 1 of the 4 players Kallari killed built physical armor (Bayle).

copy.text: Lotus (Early Bloom + Immaculate): 53.2% in 186 Kallari jungle games, above the hero's 46.8%. Proven this patch: worth copying.

loadout.name: Sniper Shells
loadout.text: Howitzer's Basic Attacks grant him 4% Total Attack Speed and 1.5% Omnivamp for 4.5s, stacking up to 5 times.
loadout.plain: Each basic attack stacks attack speed and omnivamp, up to 5 times. Omnivamp heals you from all damage, abilities included, so keep firing between abilities in lane to trade and heal back.

loadout.name: Thraex
loadout.text: Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).
loadout.plain: Your basic attacks mark the hero you hit: more damage to them, less from them. Good in lane trades where you keep shooting one target.

loadout.name: The King
loadout.text: Basic Attacks against Enemy Heroes grant you 6 gold.
loadout.plain: Basic attacks on heroes give you gold. Poke the enemy laner with your cannon to get ahead in items.

loadout.name: Ferocity
loadout.text: Gain 1% Total Attack Speed per 1s in Hero Combat, stacking infinitely.
loadout.plain: Attack speed keeps climbing for every second you stay in a hero fight. Helps an attack-focused Howitzer in long fights.

loadout.name: Typhoon
loadout.text: Cyclone: On Successful Basic Attacks: Gain a stack of Cyclone On-Hit for 3s. Each stack increases your Attack Speed by 3 (+3%)%. Stacks up to 4 times. Mirage: When at 4 stacks of Cyclone: Dash a short distance. Mirages:
loadout.plain: Basic attacks stack attack speed, and full stacks give a short dash. Fits a Howitzer who fights with his cannon and needs to reposition.
